name: depthwizard-desktop
description: DepthWizard Electron application for macOS, Windows and Linux
author: DepthWizard contributors

scripts.desktop:pack: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --dir --publish never
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
scripts.desktop:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.desktop:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --publish never
scripts.desktop:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --linux --x64 --publish never
